title: Misamis Oriental town halts F2F classes over rising dengue cases

blocks.text: TALISAYAN, Misamis Oriental — Face-to-face classes in all public and private schools here are temporarily suspended effective Friday following a sharp rise in dengue cases and three reported deaths in the town. Mayor Ciriaco Talines on Thursday directed schools to shift to modular and other appropriate alternative learning modalities in line with Department of Education (DepEd) guidelines until the dengue situation significantly improves and the order is lifted. Based on a situation report from the Municipal Health Office (MHO), the town recorded 132 dengue cases in 2026, a 158.8 percent increase from the 51 cases recorded in 2025, with three fatalities.
